name: TAF Inpatient Claims Line File
description: The TAF Inpatient Claims Line file contains line-level records for inpatient hospital services billed to Medicaid. Each record represents one service line on an inpatient claim and includes procedure codes, revenue codes, units of service, and line-level payment amounts. Note: not all states are available in TAF data from 2014-2015, as this was a transition period between MAX and TAF. From 2016-2018, all states are available.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: TAF Inpatient Claims Line
description: Line-level inpatient records from the CMS T-MSIS Analytic Files (TAF). Each row represents one service line on an inpatient facility claim submitted to Medicaid, containing procedure codes, revenue codes, service dates, units of service, and line-level payment information.

content.bene_id: String: BENE_ID. Encrypted CCW beneficiary identifier assigned to uniquely identify an individual across CCW files.
content.msis_id: String: MSIS_ID. State beneficiary identifier used in T-MSIS claims files.
content.state_cd: String: STATE_CD. Two-letter postal abbreviation for the state that submitted the TAF claim.
content.submitting_state: String: SUBMTG_STATE_CD. Numeric state or entity code for the submitting state, territory, District of Columbia, or related submitting entity.
content.clm_id: String: CLM_ID. Unique CCW claim identifier used to link header, line, and related claim records.
content.line_num: String: LINE_NUM. Unique number identifying the claim transaction line being reported.
content.clm_num_orig: String: CLM_NUM_ORIG. Original claim identifier assigned by the state payment system.
content.line_num_orig: String: LINE_NUM_ORIG. Unique number identifying the transaction line number reported on the original claim.
content.clm_num_adj: String: CLM_NUM_ADJ. Adjustment claim identifier assigned by the state payment system for an adjustment claim tied to an original transaction.
content.line_num_adj: String: LINE_NUM_ADJ. Unique number identifying the claim transaction line reported on the adjustment claim.
content.adjdctn_dt: Date32[day]: ADJDCTN_DT. Date on which the state made the final adjudication on the payment status of the claim or processed the encounter record.
content.line_claim_stus_cd: String: LINE_CLAIM_STUS_CD. Status code indicating the adjudication result at the claim line level.
content.line_adjust_cd: String: LINE_ADJUST_CD. Code indicating the type of claim line adjustment record.
content.line_srvc_bgn_dt: Date32[day]: LINE_SRVC_BGN_DT. Claim line beginning date of service.
content.line_srvc_end_dt: Date32[day]: LINE_SRVC_END_DT. Claim line ending date of service.
content.bnft_type_cd: String: BNFT_TYPE_CD. Benefit type code corresponding to the service reported on the claim line.
content.tos_cd: String: TOS_CD. Type of service code classifying the service reported on the claim line.
content.xix_srvc_ctgry_cd: String: XIX_SRVC_CTGRY_CD. Title XIX service category code for the claim line.
content.xxi_srvc_ctgry_cd: String: XXI_SRVC_CTGRY_CD. Title XXI service category code for the claim line.
content.cms_64_fed_ctgry_cd: String: CMS_64_FED_CTGRY_CD. CMS-64 federal reimbursement category code indicating whether the line was matched with Title XIX, Title XXI, ACA, or other legislation.
content.rev_cntr_cd: String: REV_CNTR_CD. Revenue center code identifying a specific accommodation, ancillary service, or billing calculation on the institutional claim line.
content.actl_srvc_qty: Float64: ACTL_SRVC_QTY. Actual quantity of the drug, service, or product rendered or dispensed on the claim line.
content.alowd_srvc_qty: Float64: ALOWD_SRVC_QTY. Maximum allowed service quantity on the claim line.
content.ndc: String: NDC. National Drug Code associated with the claim line.
content.ndc_uom_cd: String: NDC_UOM_CD. Unit-of-measure code for the National Drug Code quantity reported on the claim line.
content.ndc_qty: Float64: NDC_QTY. Quantity associated with the National Drug Code on the claim line.
content.imnztn_type_cd: String: IMNZTN_TYPE_CD. Immunization type code identifying the type of immunization provided on the claim line.
content.prvdr_fac_type_cd: String: PRVDR_FAC_TYPE_CD. Provider facility type code identifying the kind of provider or facility associated with the claim line.
content.srvc_prvdr_id: String: SRVC_PRVDR_ID. State-assigned unique identifier for the servicing provider who treated the recipient.
content.srvc_prvdr_npi: String: SRVC_PRVDR_NPI. National Provider Identifier of the servicing provider who delivered the medical service or non-surgical procedure.
content.srvc_prvdr_txnmy_cd: String: SRVC_PRVDR_TXNMY_CD. Taxonomy code for the servicing provider.
content.srvc_prvdr_type_cd: String: SRVC_PRVDR_TYPE_CD. Code describing the type of servicing provider responsible for treating the patient.
content.srvc_prvdr_spclty_cd: String: SRVC_PRVDR_SPCLTY_CD. Specialty code indicating the servicing provider's area of specialty.
content.oprtg_prvdr_npi: String: OPRTG_PRVDR_NPI. National Provider Identifier of the operating provider associated with the claim line.
content.rev_cntr_chrg_amt: Float64: REV_CNTR_CHRG_AMT. Revenue center charge amount billed for the line.
content.line_mdcd_alowd_amt: Float64: LINE_MDCD_ALOWD_AMT. Line Medicaid allowed amount determined by the payer as allowable under the contract before actual payment.
content.line_mdcd_pd_amt: Float64: LINE_MDCD_PD_AMT. Line Medicaid paid amount at the claim detail level.
content.line_mdcd_ffs_equiv_amt: Float64: LINE_MDCD_FFS_EQUIV_AMT. Line Medicaid fee-for-service equivalent amount that would have been paid had the services been provided on an FFS basis.
content.line_othr_insrnc_pd_amt: Float64: LINE_OTHR_INSRNC_PD_AMT. Amount paid by insurance other than Medicare or Medicaid on the claim line.
content.ip_accmdtn_hcpcs_rate: Float64: IP_ACCMDTN_HCPCS_RATE. Accommodation HCPCS rate used on inpatient institutional line records.
content.da_run_id: Float64: DA_RUN_ID. TAF production run identifier for the file build.
content.tmsis_run_id: Float64: TMSIS_RUN_ID. Identifier for the T-MSIS data processing run that produced the source data.
content.filename: String: FILENAME. Likely a local provenance field storing the source file name.
content.year: Int64: YEAR. Likely a local partition or reporting year field maintained outside the IP line codebook schema.
